name: Master Moulder
author: Hendrik Berends
description: Clan Moulder sells monsters, and a Master Moulder is the one who decides when a monster is finished. He comes to Mordheim for the wyrdstone and stays for the material, and whatever he leads out of the ruins is rarely what he led in.

abilities.name: Beastmaster
abilities.text: Friendly fighters with the `BEAST` or `MONSTER` keyword within 6" of this fighter may re-roll failed Bravery tests.

abilities.name: Tyrannical Packmaster
abilities.text: Friendly `BEAST` and `MONSTER` fighters within 6" of this fighter count as being within 3" of a friendly `HERO` for the purposes of `Stupidity`.

abilities.name: Goading
abilities.text: Select a friendly `BEAST` or `MONSTER` fighter within (X)" of this fighter and roll a die. On a 2+, or on a 3+ if that fighter has the `MONSTER` keyword, it makes a free move action that must end closer to the nearest visible enemy fighter, and may then make a free melee attack action. Otherwise the goad turns: that fighter makes a free melee attack action targeting this fighter.
